description.value:
Whereas most SMGs compromise between higher caliber or RPM, the Eagle creates a more perfect union of both. To combat the bump in recoil, an expensive compensation system and smartlinking were added to ensure every burst is on target. Yet, when the Eagle was unveiled, regular buyers were outraged. How dare Constitutional Arms put microchips in their weapons? How dare they tell us what we want on it? Thus, sales fell dramatically short of expectations, despite most professionals giving it glowing reviews.

Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 4d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 34 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Power Rebuild, Short Scope, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. When making an Autofire (SMG 3) Attack with this weapon, if the DV to hit is only beat by 1, it still uses a (x2) multiplier.

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Power Rebuild, Short Scope, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 4d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
